item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 11/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers to Guangdong in the latter part of this week and over the weekend. A broad trough of low pressure over the central to northern parts of the South China Sea and the seas east of Luzon is expected to bring unsettled weather to the region early to midweek next week. An area of low pressure may also form over the trough of low pressure. Meanwhile, a weak northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China. Besides, the area of low pressure over the East China Sea will move towards eastern China today.
